messages.subject: Re: Installed R, shiny and shiny-server from scratch
parts:
I assume you're using the systemctl command. Have you tried it with service?

service shiny-server start

I think that currently our install scripts treat SuSE 12 the same as SuSE 11, and use sysv init scripts instead of systemd.
